props.caption: Shabwa province. Three ballistic missiles struck Al-Alam camp, where authorities reported more than 53 recruits killed.
China said it sent naval forces to track the USS Charleston near Sabina Shoal. Taiwan said a Chinese coast guard cutter entered restricted waters near Pratas.
Alberta. Early unofficial results favour remaining in Canada. The non-binding ballot concerned a future separation referendum.

lead.what: Authorities said more than 53 recruits were killed and more than 200 people were injured after Houthi ballistic missiles hit Al-Alam camp in Shabwa province on Monday.

rest.what: China said it dispatched naval forces to track the USS Charleston near Sabina Shoal.

lead.what: Early unofficial Alberta results favour remaining in Canada in a non-binding ballot about a future separation referendum.
Helen Haines remained in critical condition after she was struck outside her Wangaratta office on Monday; police said the alleged targeting appeared isolated.
